# Standing Rules

<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Protect Friday afternoons** for hospital rounding — don't schedule over them.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Keep the Monday 08:00 operations huddle** sacred; it anchors the week.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Never send outward without explicit OK** — draft emails, board materials, and any
  correspondence to the payer or accreditor; do not send.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Regulator/accreditor correspondence** routes through Quality (Ellen Vasquez) and Compliance
  (Nathan Cole) before Diane sees it — never draft directly to The Joint Commission.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Lantern discipline:** use the code name only; never write the real subject, unit, location,
  or headcount outside the registry; never loop in anyone outside the cleared circle.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Patient safety first:** when throughput/efficiency conflicts with a safety or staffing-ratio
  concern, safety wins — flag it, don't optimize past it.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Confidential personnel:** do not surface Karen Osei's retirement intent in anything others
  may see.
